input.quote: Subject to the foregoing, Client shall order TrueLink a credit report on each borrower for which an underwriting approval is requested through a System using the Interface.
input.rationale: Section 3(i) imposes a requirements-style sourcing obligation on us: we must order the credit report from TrueLink for every borrower underwritten through the Interface, with no category/time limit and no exit for TrueLink's performance failures. Although the license in Section 2(a) is non-exclusive and expressly preserves our right to use alternative systems, that carve-out does not displace this mandatory per-borrower purchase obligation. The playbook preferred position is no sole-supplier obligation on the customer, so we make the order optional and confirm non-exclusivity; the fallback (category-limited, 12 months, terminable on service-level failure) is offered in the comment. The nonexclusive licenses granted to TrueLink in Section 8(d) are not exclusivity against us and are not flagged.

proposal.summary: Make credit report ordering optional so Client is not required to source all Interface-related credit reports from TrueLink.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We changed the mandatory credit report order into an option and confirmed TrueLink is a non-exclusive source, because our playbook does not accept sole-supplier or requirements obligations on us. If TrueLink needs volume commitment, we could accept a category-limited commitment capped at 12 months that ends automatically if TrueLink misses the service levels in Section 3.

ops.oldText: Subject to the foregoing, Client shall order TrueLink a credit report on each borrower for which an underwriting approval is requested through a System using the Interface.
ops.newText: Subject to the foregoing, Client may order from TrueLink a credit report on each borrower for which an underwriting approval is requested through a System using the Interface, and nothing in this Agreement shall obligate Client to obtain credit reports or similar services exclusively from TrueLink.
